reviews.author: Amber Mavilla
reviews.text: Broke down on my way to work, insurance wanted way too much and was going take too long. I called on a Sunday at 9:30am and was back on track by 10am thanks to them! So fast, so nice and way cheaper than insurance. THANKS SO MUCH!!

reviews.author: Sandra Parzych
reviews.text: This is not a review but a complaint. I was driving on Rt 65 a couple days ago. From the railroad tracks the speed limit is 35. I do the speed limit. I have seen many get speeding tickets on this stretch of this road. I had your truck behind me. He was so close to my bumper I couldn’t believe it. I don’t know why people , for one thing, don’t pay attention to speed limit signs, and why drivers feel as tho they have to be on my bumper. If that is an attempt to made me go faster , it doesn’t work. It has the opposite effect.

reviews.author: natalie cunningham
reviews.text: I was calling around to different tow companies in the area and they were giving me outrageous estimates for short distances. I called Snag and Drag and they were quick to send someone out for me! They gave me a good price and were very kind in the process. I would recommend this company to anyone in need of towing!

reviews.author: Alissa Airel
reviews.text: The gentleman at this location is so kind, trustworthy and helpful. I would recommend them anytime any-day.

reviews.author: Andrew Torsiello
reviews.text: These folks I highly recommend. Best price around for Conway area. They where fast as can be , I was surprised when they called to confirm where to put it , I was for sure he was just picking it up but nah he was asking me where to drop it lol. Highly recommend. They will get it done.

reviews.author: maria underwood
reviews.text: Hopefully I won't need to use him again, but I will Always highly recommend this company to anyone who needs these services. Very friendly, understanding guy. Was open about his availability, reasonably priced, and updated me as soon as my car was at its destination.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Jones
reviews.text: Greg was efficient, polite, fast, and friendly. I felt so at ease working with him and highly recommend his company. Thank you for providing such wonderful service on a Sunday night! Horry County is blessed to have this service available.

reviews.author: Bonnie Braxton
reviews.text: Weekend trip didn't end like it should have...18 miles from home...car died..no warning.. thankfull for all the help I was given...Snag and Drag towing was a part of all that. Great pricing, very courteous and knowledgeable. Thank you again!

reviews.author: Toni Clark
reviews.text: Snag and drag to the rescue! I was in an accident and pretty shaken up, Greg was there not long after I called. He towed my car and even calmed me down! He gave great advice and was affordable. Glad he was there to assist and I highly recommend their company! Thanks again :)

reviews.author: Katie Houle
reviews.text: This has by far been the best towing service I have used. Everyone I dealt with was super polite. Although I needed last minute help they didn’t make me feel like I was an inconvenience like a lot of other places do. The professionalism and punctually was top notch. They called not only when they were at the pick up location, but after they dropped off the truck. I will use them again if I ever need a tow!

reviews.author: malachi larose
reviews.text: Highly recommend these guys!! They towed my toolbox to my house very quickly, and they are extremely affordable! 10 out of 10 will be using them again.

reviews.author: Stephen
reviews.text: Called on a Sunday night. He came in 15 mins and took great care of me. Did NOT over charge. More than fair!!!! Will send anyone there. Honest. Trustworthy.

reviews.author: Marcellus Smith
reviews.text: Professional, Reliable and Reasonable prices. That comes along with knowledgeable and great customer service.

reviews.author: jill Gentry
reviews.text: we own a repair facility and snag and drag is ALWAYS the tow company we call first! always on time and always a pleasure to do business with

reviews.author: Bradley Steen
reviews.text: These people were so nice and tried to everything they could to help me out! I highly recommend them! Thanks guys you are the best in the business!

reviews.author: Aaron Murawa
reviews.text: Amazing service. I needed my car towed and they showed up incredibly fast, and they were able to answer all of the questions I had.

reviews.author: Arianna Rochester
reviews.text: The driver was so friendly, and even remembered my husband from a previous time he had to tow him. Great service and very fast!

reviews.author: Jackie Strickland
reviews.text: Best in county. Very friendly and on time. Gives good advice. I would recommend him any time or day.

reviews.author: Redfox Foxofnc
reviews.text: Called to have a car picked up and towed to my house. Stated he was too busy to accommodate my request. Very rude and condescending.
